material.acceptance_criteria: Skill-up with no hero selected calls refuse(who, 'noHero'), the same as the cast and item keys, and the player sees 'select a hero first'.
material.description: scenarios/moba/controls.lua:369-372 skill_up returns silently when hero_selected is nil. The same no-hero case refuses with the 'noHero' text elsewhere: cast_key at :317, item_key at :336, resolve_armed at :353. scenarios/moba/moba_ui.json:176 supplies the text 'select a hero first'. The HUD path on_action('skill_up') (:~426) reaches the same silent return. Symptom: a player who presses the skill-up key with a non-hero selection sees nothing happen, while the cast key shows the reason. Visibility of system status (Nielsen heuristic 1) is violated for this one key. The sim-side refusal (no skill point) is not covered here: cmd_skill_up sends no answer to the mod.

notes.note: Citation fix: the HUD path on_action('skill_up') is scenarios/moba/controls.lua:555 (calls skill_up at :555), not ~426. Confirmed the other cites: :317, :336, :353 refuse noHero; :369 skill_up silent; moba_ui.json:176.

Published controls.lua 5204edb9 (skill_up with no hero refuses noHero). Witness blocked: Live check (browser dispatch 1792862772886-5303-5a481f4722e0f263, session verify-PARSEDV-trav-controls-lua-1, page https://lanmower.github.io/oscraft/js/client/play.html at 1280x720): the lobby joins a room but stays at "loading world assets: still pending after 15 s"; console shows WebSocket wss://relay.damus.io/ handshake 503. A match cannot start, so the in-game witness is blocked by lobby-disabled-when-one-relay-503. CI 5204edb9 red on the existing workspace-tests row.

material.subject: Skill-up key with no hero selected does nothing and shows no message, unlike the cast and item keys
material.witness: Live Pages site (play.html, 1280x720, isolated browser session): with a non-hero unit selected (oscraft.selectUnit), Control+q prints refusal 'select a hero first' (data-ui=refusal, display block). Fix commit 5204edb9 is an ancestor of green tip 7f68d3bc (ci success 6/6).
material.witness_plan: Live page: select a non-hero unit, press the skill-up key, and confirm the refusal text appears. Static: codesearch 'refuse(who, "noHero")' in scenarios/moba/controls.lua shows the skill_up path absent.
